name: Alexander James (wrestler)
profileSummary: Alexander James Winkler is an American professional wrestler, better known by his ring name Alexander James. He is signed to WWE, where he works as a coach at the WWE Performance Center and also serves as a producer for their NXT brand. He is best known for his tenures with Combat Zone Wrestling, Westside Xtreme Wrestling (wXw) and most recently NJPW Strong.
